Launched in January 2012 Mom Bloggers for Social Good is a global coalition of mothers who care about spreading the good news about the amazing work non-profit organizations and NGOs are doing around the world.

The blog is a Nigerian Lifestyle blog that covers topics like family, relationship, pregnancy and childbirth, parenting, health, fashion, blogging, and general knowledge topics.

feeds.title: Afrolems Nigerian Food Blog
feeds.description: Afrolems is an African food blog with a specialization in Nigerian Food. Our main focus is to stylize African food so it can be internationalized. We aim to educate our followers with kitchen tips, Cooking Know-hows and interesting recipes from all over Africa and just modifications of recipes from other cultures. We also like to play with foreign recipes as well.

feeds.title: Wives Connection
feeds.description: We focus basically on life in Nigeria and how it affects Nigerian women especially wives and Mothers. We share our burdens, discuss, and try to find solutions from shared experiences. Food is very important to our families, so, we share recipes for babies and food recipes for the whole family.

feeds.title: Momplete
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Chantal, owner of Momplete. I'm an aspiring actuary by profession, but truly a passionate writer at heart. I'm Nigerian-born but live in Jamaica with my family of four. If you're a mother interested in exploring options that offer you a level of flexibility you've always dreamed of, you've come to the right place.
